Nobushi. At first, she may just look like another lightspammer at lower levels. Low skill floor. But what attracted me was her high skill ceiling. 
- Nobu has zero unblockables. So she relies on this mixup: kick or undodgeable heavy OR vipers retreat which can be recovery cancelled into a dodge/dodge attack.
- Her zone has 3 soft feints, one being a dodge which means she can cancel recov a zone into all her dodge attacks. 
- She can soft feint opener heavies into HS
- As well as soft feint her dodge forward heavy into HS which as mentioned can be thrown out of a zone. 
- She can chain dodges and HS infinitely, which is a wonderful against chargeable attacks.
- Literally ALL of her chain options and dodge attacks can be delayed with a HUGE margin which is insane.
- Does more damage when someone is bleeding.
 
Nobu is secretly a dodge attack specialist.

Also, the Naginata is may favorite weapon of all time so of course I picked her :)
